scope: Official XMRig Windows x64 release; code-owned CPU-only RandomX configuration, 2 threads, <=15 minutes/run, Windows Job CPU/memory limits, public payout address only.
checks: Downloaded archive digest equals GitHub release-asset digest and publisher SHA256SUMS; extracted executable independently hashed.
Read scoped configuration/parser, pool, RandomX, CPU and donation source files at pinned tag. No claim of whole-program or independent binary reproducibility audit.
Extract only xmrig.exe; never extract WinRing0x64.sys, bundled batch scripts or configuration. rdmsr/wrmsr and huge pages disabled; no administrator action.
GPU disabled. Local API restricted and authenticated on loopback. Environment excludes wallet/model credentials. Command and endpoint are owned by code.
Wallet CLI adapter permits only read commands and an exact USDT/BSC quote, never signing, trading or sending.

unMineable website's current JS publishes v5 address/account read endpoints and POST v1/address/{uuid}/setting/auto_pay. Only enable automatic payout to the verified BSC wallet within the confirmed run scope.
limitations: This is a scoped integration review, not a guarantee that a third-party binary is free of vulnerabilities or malware.
Windows Job Objects limit resources and terminate descendants; they do not isolate the filesystem or network.
The published Stratum SSL endpoint uses a self-signed certificate. First-use fingerprint pinning limits later certificate changes but does not independently authenticate the initial server.
Pool credit is custodial and subject to conversion, fees, payout threshold, service availability and counterparty risk. A quote establishes current tradability, not positive net mining profit.
Accepted shares, pool credit and on-chain wallet receipt must be reported separately; no on-chain payout may be claimed without transaction evidence.
